sections.extracted_fact: ICML Area Chairs base informed meta-reviews on reviews and discussion rather than numerical-score aggregation.

verbatim_excerpts.text: Each meta-review should summarize the key points that justify your accept/reject recommendation, whether from the reviews themselves or the (anonymized) discussions.
Your recommendations and meta-reviews should be informed by the review content, as opposed to just relying on average (or other aggregate) numerical scores.

verbatim_excerpts.source_locator: Best Practices for Writing Meta-Reviews > rebuttals and comments
verbatim_excerpts.text: If authors raised concerns about poor quality of reviews and/or disengaged reviewers, please assure them that you as an AC have read their rebuttals/comments and incorporated them in your decision making.
important contradictions between reviews, or if any key aspects of the paper remain unclear to a reviewer
